brief: The canvas displays overlapping, layered structures that appear like deep-sea sediment and knitted fiber. Mineralized fossil patterns emerge from a continuous background of rich, muted blues and earth tones, suggesting slow geological time. These intricate, crystalline pathways are formed by the unseen currents of forgotten memory. The patterns shift and crystallize slowly across the surface, with faint, organic geometries suggesting life preserved within solid, repeating lattices. The viewer observes the gradual, almost imperceptible crystallization of the pathways as new layers accrue over old ones, mapping historical records into physical structure.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive visualization of deep-sea sedimentary layers and fossilized crystalline patterns emerging from a muted blue and earth-toned background. Using WebGL rendering, it draws slowly evolving structures that appear to form through geological time — organic geometries suggest preserved life within solid lattices. The patterns shift imperceptibly across the canvas as new layers accrue over time, mapping historical records into physical structure. The visual effect combines fluid organic growth with crystalline mineral formations, evoking the patient, cyclical processes of sedimentation and fossilization in oceanic depths.
